statusMenu.title: Change status

hint.todo: Queued for the executor to start
hint.inProgress: The executor is working on it
hint.inReview: Finished, waiting for you; tasks that depend on it go ahead
hint.blocked: Needs your decision to go on
hint.cancelledDependents: Dropped; the {{count}} tasks waiting for it become blocked
hint.cancelledDependents_one: Dropped; the {{count}} task waiting for it becomes blocked
hint.cancelledDependents_other: Dropped; the {{count}} tasks waiting for it become blocked

statusMenu.cancelTree: Cancel this tree (with its unfinished subtasks)…
statusMenu.cancelTreeTitle: Cancel #{{number}} and the tasks under it?
statusMenu.cancelTreeDescription: The {{count}} unfinished subtasks under it are cancelled with it.
statusMenu.cancelTreeDescription_one: The {{count}} unfinished subtask under it is cancelled with it.
statusMenu.cancelTreeDescription_other: The {{count}} unfinished subtasks under it are cancelled with it.
statusMenu.cancelTreeCounting: The unfinished subtasks under it are cancelled with it (counting…).

queueReason.taskBusy: Waiting for this task's previous run to end
queueReason.machineFull: {{machine}} is running as many tasks as it may; waiting for a slot
queueReason.machineOffline: {{machine}} is offline; it starts when it connects
queueReason.waitingDepsUnknown: Waiting for the tasks it depends on

runs.label: Run
runs.fromScratchHint: A comment lets the executor carry on where it stopped; this opens a session that remembers nothing.
runs.parentHint: A parent task does not run itself: its status comes from its subtasks.

scope.emptyGroup: No tasks in this group yet

fields.title: Title
fields.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Fix the login page layout in Safari

empty.title: No tasks yet
empty.description: An agent proposes a task in a conversation; once you confirm it, the agent gets to work and records each step in the timeline.

activity.noReplyReminder: This turn ended without a report; one reminder was sent
activity.dependencyAddedDone: now waits for {{task}}, and only done lets it go
activity.dependencyRequireDone: now waits for {{task}} to be done, not only in review
activity.dependencyRequireAny: now lets {{task}} go once it is in review or done
activity.dependencyDeleted: {{task}} was deleted, so this no longer waits for it
activity.dependencyBlocked: {{task}} was cancelled, so this will not start on its own. Remove the dependency, or cancel this task.
activity.dependencyUnblocked: no dependency is cancelled any more, so this goes back to todo and starts once what it waits for is resolved
activity.parentCleared: is no longer a subtask of {{task}}
activity.parentDeleted: {{task}} was deleted, so this is no longer a subtask of it
activity.subtaskRemoved: {{task}} is no longer a subtask of this
activity.subtasksAllCancelled: every subtask is cancelled, so nothing is left to work on. Add a subtask, or decide what becomes of this task.

log.title: Execution log
log.compacted: Context compacted; what came before is a summary
log.branched: The earlier branch is a summary

draft.title: Task draft
draft.notCreatedHint: Confirming creates the task; the agent that proposed it runs it in {{workspace}}.
draft.startNowHint: Confirming starts the task right away.
draft.backlogHint: Confirming puts it in the backlog; it will not run until you move it to To do.

comments.title: Comments
comments.unsupportedAttachments: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} files weren't added.
comments.unsupportedAttachments_one: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} file wasn't added.
comments.unsupportedAttachments_other: Comments can't include images or files yet; {{count}} files weren't added.
comments.placeholder: Reply; a running task reads it right away

delete.confirmDescription: Its description, comments and activity are deleted and can't be restored.

graph.requireDoneHint: Only done lets this task start; unchecked, in review is enough
graph.blockedHint: A task this one depends on was cancelled, so it will not start on its own. Remove that dependency, or cancel this task.
graph.parentCommentHint: A parent task starts no new run because of a comment. To change the work, comment on a subtask or add one.

views.label: View
views.newHint: Agents draft tasks and you confirm them: say what you want done in a conversation, and the agent drafts a task card for you to confirm.

cards.blockedCancelled: “{{title}}”, which it waits for, was cancelled
cards.blockedCancelledMany: {{count}} tasks it waits for were cancelled
cards.blockedCancelledMany_one: {{count}} task it waits for was cancelled
cards.blockedCancelledMany_other: {{count}} tasks it waits for were cancelled
cards.blockedAllCancelled: All its subtasks were cancelled; you decide
cards.blockedDecide: Needs your decision to go on

refusal.cycle: Waits for this one: a cycle

plan.addStep: Add a step at the end
plan.addStepHint: Ask in this work's conversation for a subtask that waits for the last step
plan.addStepDraft: Add a step at the end of #{{number}} “{{title}}”: draft a subtask (part of #{{number}}, waiting for {{tasks}}). It should:
plan.connect: Drag a task's right edge onto another to make that one wait for it
plan.connectHint: Pick another task to make it wait for #{{number}}; Esc cancels
plan.cycle: That would close a cycle; letting go does nothing
plan.edgeLabel: #{{to}} waits for #{{from}}: remove it or change when it lets go
plan.addStepDraftFirst: Add a step to #{{number}} “{{title}}”: draft a subtask (part of #{{number}}). It should:
plan.exists: #{{to}} waits for #{{from}} already; letting go does nothing. Use the edge's menu to change when it lets go
